name: Gold Nugget
description: A soft piece of recovered gold. Valuable as a conductive crafting material, but never treated as currency in Omnia.

name: Broken Trinket
description: A damaged keepsake whose fittings and small components can still serve the city.

name: Essence of Nature
description: Condensed living resonance gathered from vigorous Tower growth.

name: Exquisite Gem
description: A flawless gemstone fit for precision enchantment and high-order focusing arrays.

name: Mushrooms
description: Edible Tower fungi used in meals, poultices, and basic alchemy.

name: Mystery Box
description: A sealed salvage container whose locking mechanism has outlived its maker.

name: Old Boot
description: Waterlogged footwear; poor equipment, but usable leather and hardware remain.

name: Old Relic
description: A weathered object of uncertain origin, useful to historians even when its function is lost.

name: Pearl
description: A lustrous organic gemstone formed in the Tower's strange waters.

name: Royal Emblem
description: An authenticated mark of vanished authority, prized by archivists and collectors.

name: Rusty Key
description: A corroded key that may still fit one forgotten lock—or yield useful metal.

name: Shard of Harmony
description: A resonant fragment that settles nearby frequencies into a coherent pattern.

name: Shard of Tranquility
description: A cool fragment whose resonance suppresses agitation and unstable magic.

name: Small Gem
description: A modest cut or natural gemstone suited to trade, tools, and low-order enchantment.

name: Venestria's heart
description: The abandoned Reyvateil's crystallized core, still carrying the ache of an unfinished song.
